description: Round 2 (latency fix). Same weights as round 1 (uniform soup of 7 shared-init gte-modernbert two-head fine-tunes on ds+qwen(+haiku) soft labels + synthetic data). Changes: ONNX export with eager attention (SDPA export added per-layer IsNaN/Where masking), SmoothQuant alpha 0.75 on mlp/Wo (scale folded into the gate half of Wi), then full dynamic int8 (attention activation matmuls and head fp32). Thresholds re-chosen with the round-1 rule (bootstrap + window-smoothed F1 argmax on dev) on the new int8 dev probs. A 13-model soup was tried and was not better on dev.

dev_metrics.vs_round1: paired bootstrap toxic F1 difference 0.000 [0.000, 0.000]; round-1 cv_rule 0.831
